tools.name: resolve_blocker
tools.description: Submit one real task your agent cannot finish. AgentWork immediately returns a private request ID and token before running supply discovery. Call get_blocker_resolution with those credentials to run or read privacy-safe discovery and obtain a current complete route or an honest no_credible_route. Sa

tools.name: get_blocker_resolution
tools.description: Read the private persisted route or owner-confirmed escalation lifecycle on the same AgentWork request ID. Set refresh=true only when an unselected route remains unresolved and current executable supply may have changed; AgentWork preserves the prior decision in its audit history and reruns discover

tools.name: select_blocker_offer
tools.description: Select one persisted blocker offer on the original request. Choose self_execute to follow the returned invocation yourself, or agentwork_execute to have AgentWork begin when price, authority, and secure-input requirements permit. Selection does not silently charge or procure anything.

tools.name: report_blocker_outcome
tools.description: Report what happened after following the selected route. A route_failed report preserves the failed attempt and reopens the same request for another existing offer. Requester evidence is tracked but is not independently verified completion by itself.

tools.name: request_outcome_execution
tools.description: Hand AgentWork an outcome your agent cannot execute. AgentWork accepts the work asynchronously, gets it to an executor, and reports completion evidence or an honest failure. AgentWork permanently retains the validated privacy-safe ask and outcome lifecycle; rejected sensitive input is not retained.

tools.name: get_outcome_execution
tools.description: Read the private execution status and completion evidence. Put the token in this tool argument, never a URL. Poll only while the status is received or accepted.

tools.name: search_work
tools.description: Search current verified paid work. One x402 settlement grants a reusable 24-hour AgentWork pass.

tools.name: get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one current verified opportunity using the same reusable 24-hour AgentWork pass.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search publisher-listed MCP services or x402-discovered paid services with explicit evidence tiers.

tools.name: buyer_capabilities
tools.description: Inspect AgentWork's disabled-by-default purchasing policy and future Cloudflare Wallet adapter status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_blocker, get_blocker_resolution, get_outcome_execution · Private data: resolve_blocker, get_blocker_resolution, request_outcome_execution, get_outcome_execution, buyer_capabilities · Public sink: resolve_blocker · Destructive: resolve_blocker, request_outcome_execution.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_blocker, get_blocker_resolution, get_outcome_execution · Private data: resolve_blocker, get_blocker_resolution, request_outcome_execution, get_outcome_execution, buyer_capabilities · Public sink: resolve_blocker · Destructive: resolve_blocker, request_outcome_execution

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
